generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Sample from a pool of realistic short strings; 5% of rows get a near-variant of a pool value (case flip, trailing space, one-char edit); 2% get '' when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_id: Sample from a pool of realistic identifier strings (lowercase letters + digits, 8-10 chars); 5% near-variants (case flip, one-char edit); 2% '' when nullable; boundary literals from per_column_exceptions are injected into the pool verbatim.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Sample from a pool of realistic person/place names; 5% near-variants (case flip, trailing space); 2% '' when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_note: Sample from a small pool of note strings; 90% NULL when nullable, else a pool value.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_small: Uniform integer in [0, 20]; 5% at min-1/max+1 boundary when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_year: Uniform integer in [1909, 2011]; 5% at min-1/max+1 boundary.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_count: Uniform integer in [0, 100]; 5% at min-1/max+1 boundary.
generic_sampling_rules.text_numeric: Numeric value rendered as TEXT, uniform integer in [0, 400]; 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_flag: One of a small enum pool; 5% NULL when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For each nullable column, 5-30% of generated rows are NULL (per column statistics), at least one NULL row per nullable column; NOT NULL and primary-key columns never get NULL; FK-parent join-key columns listed in UNMATCHED_PARENT get at most 20% NULL so unused non-NULL parent values remain for unmatched-parent targets; other nullable FK child columns use the general 5-30% share.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicates: For DISTINCT-target columns, 20-50% of rows share a value with another row; planting runs only on non-PK columns or after PK re-dedup; post-generation verify the share on surviving rows.
generic_sampling_rules.ties: For ORDER/LIMIT-target columns, plant at least two rows tied at the listed rank; when the tie target is an aggregate (SUM/COUNT/COALESCE), construct the underlying per-group values so the aggregate ties at the specified rank with no smaller value present, and plant after PK/UNIQUE dedup and NULL application; re-verify after final re-dedup and after write-time skips.
generic_sampling_rules.unmatched_parent: For each UNMATCHED_PARENT target, reserve at least one non-NULL parent value (or full parent tuple for composite keys) never drawn by any child; verify after generation and after write-time skips that at least one parent row with a non-NULL key has no child.
generic_sampling_rules.group_sizes: For GROUP_SIZE targets, plant groups of size 1, 2 and >=3 on non-key columns or on rows whose PK components are not disturbed; re-verify after final re-dedup and after write-time skips.
generic_sampling_rules.hard_bounds: All range, enum and order rules in semantic_rules_and_formulas are hard constraints: every generated row must satisfy them on non-NULL operands; clamp numeric output to [lo,hi] after any jitter.

Master.playerID and Scoring.playerID are declared nullable TEXT in the schema but act as join keys; NULL share capped at 5-20% so unused non-NULL parent values remain for unmatched-parent targets.
uncertainty: Exact numeric ranges for count columns are inferred from statistics distinct counts and sample values, not from CHECK constraints.
Master.deathYear >= birthYear order rule holds on shown rows but is not enforced by schema; stated conditionally and enforced by resampling when both non-NULL.
Master.playerID / Scoring.playerID NULLs: schema permits NULL; spec allows 5-20% NULL and documents that unmatched-parent targets are satisfied by non-NULL unused parent values only.
Unmatched-parent targets on composite keys (Teams.year, Teams.tmID) require reserving a full (year,tmID) tuple; program must re-verify post-generation and after write-time skips.

Goalies.SHO COALESCE(SHO,0) tie at rank 1 planted by two NULL rows (values 0) with no smaller non-NULL value; SUM(SHO) tie planted by controlling all rows of two chosen players and capping every other player's per-player SUM below the tie value; re-verify after final re-dedup and after write-time skips.
Group-size and duplicate planting must run after PK dedup and be followed by a re-dedup/assertion for composite PKs (Goalies, Scoring); re-verify after write-time skips.

Tie targets on aggregates (SUM(goalies.sho), COUNT(*) by birthCountry) require constructing underlying per-group values; planting is done after PK/UNIQUE dedup and NULL application, and re-verified after final re-dedup and write-time skips.
Boundary literal 'x' for Master.playerID/coachID is not producible by the 8-10 char ID sampler; it is injected into the sampler pool verbatim from per_column_exceptions.
Master.height boundary requires guaranteed presence of exact values 72 and 73 (plain or slash form) so the predicate master.height > 72 has equal-and-one-step-from coverage.
Write-time skipped rows (PK/UNIQUE/NOT NULL/FK violations) can invalidate planted targets; target verification must run on actually-written rows.
